The rule about canonical register form applies to number/year format differences. For name spelling, the document spelling is correct; register has the typo. So best_value = document's.

Verdict: same-entity, best_value: "Zhonghang Electronic Measuring Instruments (Xi'an) Co., Ltd.", why: the extra "c" in the register is a spelling drift/typo of the same company name confirmed by the certificate document.
